extractedBy: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), overnight run agentpack-batch6, extraction worker
notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/actiontile.guide.tsx, which only registers it, and the Action Tile parts of the shared src/ActionGuides.tsx: actionTileModes, ActionTileExample, QuickActionsExample, ActionableTileStateExample, ActionTilePlayground and actionTileSections; the ActionFooter and Additem parts belong to other guides) and docs/evidence/actiontile.md at cba512f. The guide's Sources note says “Checked 19 September 2026” and that the public export is jfs-components 0.1.60. The evidence names no date or build; its items carry the Sources note's date and build (an assumption: it is the check the guide cites), so every item resting on the evidence is flagged as stale. That 0.1.60 sentence is out of date and not used. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October); the package CHANGELOG names no ActionTile change after 0.1.54. Installed ActionTile.tsx and IconCapsule.tsx still match every guide and evidence sentence used here, read from source, not run: the props are label (default “Cards”, Figma's default text), icon, modes, onPress and style; the tile is a View fixed at width 168 and height 90 with the actionTile tokens (white background, radius 16, 12 px horizontal and 16 px vertical padding, 8 px gap, a 14 px label); a React element in icon is cloned with the tile's merged modes (the provider's, then the tile's own), so it receives the owner's full mode object; with no icon the tile draws a default IconCapsule (iconName ic_card); with onPress the whole tile is one pressable, without it the plain View is returned; there is no disabled or loading prop. No guide sentence is contradicted on 0.1.78, but three things read wider than the guide, from the source, not run: the cloned modes replace any modes set on the IconCapsule itself; style is spread after the fixed size, so a style patch can resize the tile (the guide says not to); the label has no line limit and nothing clips the tile, so a sentence-long label wraps in the 144 px text width and runs past the 90 px bottom edge (which backs the Don't against a sentence label). Modes: the guide sets Primary appearance with Medium emphasis on every tile (with Color Mode Light, Context Default, Page type MainPage, Semantic Intent Brand and Icon Capsule Size M) to match a Storybook reference; that is a choice for the guide's pictures, not a rule that some content needs it, so under the building rules the examples set no modes and no Color Mode, and the tiles take the package defaults (Primary, High). With the package's resolver that is a gold #cea15a capsule with a dark icon, where the guide's Medium is a pale #fde8c9 capsule with a gold icon and Figma's live Neutral, High a dark #303338 capsule with a white icon; the tile itself is the same white in all three. That mismatch is recorded as a gap. “Two actions in one place” is not applied: the guide's quick actions are peer shortcuts with one look, none leading. The In context HStack's modes are dropped, and its alignVertical flex-start too (HStack's default); wrap is kept (layout). The icon slot holds an IconCapsule with the guide's iconName (ic_cards, ic_savings, ic_payments, all in the installed icon registry); IconCapsule has no entry in this pack, and the examples use it because the guide supplies the icon that way and the package's icon doc expects one (as the BrandChip entry does with Avatar); it carries no modes, since the tile passes its own. Copy is the guide's own (Cards, Savings, Payments); press handlers are stubs. Left out of examples: the In context and state readouts (“Choose a destination.”, “Ready to open Payments.”: documentation lines, not Coin), the playground and its Color mode control, the wide and narrow hosts (documentation frames) and the Don'ts. Not recorded: style beyond the guide's no-resize rule (the building rules keep style off Coin components); the pressed opacity and the screen-reader name and role, which the guide doesn't cover and the pack's rules keep out of gaps; the evidence's Storybook story ids. Accessibility is empty: the guide says nothing about it. The Sources note renders whole: no line has a missing value. Sorting (batch 6): the cross-check found that gap 1 said more than the evidence (the package defaults, Primary with High, are read from the package's token resolver, not the evidence), so the gap now says only what the evidence records; the package-default finding is kept here and reported on Component Fix #419 (IconCapsule's default is gold where Figma is Neutral).
